Give the importance of buffer stocks in the agricultural market model.

options.A: Buffer stocks eliminate the need for agricultural subsidies.
options.B: Buffer stocks result in price fluctuation.
options.C: Buffer stocks ensure a constant decrease in the market price of crops.
options.D: Buffer stocks provide unlimited income for farmers.
options.E: Buffer stocks are primarily used to control the export of crops.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - Buffer stocks eliminate the need for agricultural subsidies.

questions.stem_text: Which of the following could be used as a test for autocorrelation up to third order?
questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - The Dickey-Fuller test

questions.stem_text: What is meant by the technically efficient methodof production?

options.A: A method that minimizes the time taken to produce a product
options.B: A method that uses more of all inputs to increase output
options.C: A method that produces the highest quantity of output
options.D: A method that relies solely on the latest technology
options.E: A method that achieves the fastest production speed regardless of resource usage

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - A method that minimizes the time taken to produce a product

Suppose that current disposable income is $10000 and consumption spending is $8000. For
every $100 increase in disposable income saving increases $10. Given this information

options.A: the marginal propensity to save is .80.
options.B: the marginal propensity to save is .90.
options.C: the marginal propensity to save is .20.
options.D: the marginal propensity to consume is .20.
options.E: the marginal propensity to save is .50.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - the marginal propensity to save is .80.
